}} '''Nikola Peković''' (born [[3 January]], [[1986]]) is a [[Montenegrins|Montenegrin]] professional [[basketball]] player. He is currently with [[Panathinaikos B.C.]] of the [[A1 Ethniki|Greek League]] and the [[Euroleague]]. ==Pro Career== Pekovic began his basketball career playing with the [[KK Budućnost Podgorica]] basketball club's junior team department in the 2001-02 season. From there, he went on to go play for [[KK Atlas]] in 2002 and he played for them until 2005, when he moved to [[KK Partizan]]. With [[KK Partizan|Partizan]], he won 3 [[Naša Sinalko Liga|Serbian League]] Championships (2006, 2007, 2008), 2 [[NLB League|Adriatic League]] Championships (2007, 2008), and the [[Serbia Basketball Cup|Serbian Cup]] in 2008. He was named the [[MVP]] of the [[NLB League|Adriatic League]] Final Four in 2008. In 2008, Pekovic joined the Greek club [[Panathinaikos B.C.]] He signed a 3 year contract worth €4.5 million [[Euro|euros]] net pay. ==International Career== ====Serbia and Montenegro National Team==== In 2005, while playing with the Serbia and Montenegro national Under-21 basketball team, he received the bronze medal in Russia at the [[FIBA Europe]] Under-20 European Championship. At the 2006 [[FIBA Europe]] Under-20 European Championship held in [[İzmir]], he won the gold medal with his national team. ====Montenegro National Team==== Pekovic is currently a member of the senior men's [[Montenegro national basketball team|Montenegrin National Basketball Team]]. ==Awards and Accomplishments== ====Pro Career==== *Won 3 [[Naša Sinalko Liga|Serbian League]] Championships with [[KK Partizan]] (2006, 2007, 2008) *Won 2 [[NLB League|Adriatic League]] Championships with [[KK Partizan]] (2007, 2008) *Won the [[Serbia Basketball Cup|Serbian Cup]] with [[KK Partizan]] (2008) *[[NLB League|Adriatic League]] Final Four [[MVP]] (2008) *All-[[Euroleague]] 2nd Team [[Euroleague 2007-08]] ====National Team==== *Won the bronze medal at the [[FIBA Europe]] Under-20 European Championship (2005) *Won the gold medal at the [[FIBA Europe]] Under-20 European Championship (2006) ==External Links== *[http://www.basketpedya.com/Acc002InfJug.php?idjug=41968&idioma=3 Career & stats basketpedya.com] *[http://www.euroleague.net/competition/players/showplayer?clubcode=par&pcode=KNN Euroleague.net player profile] *[http://www.adriaticbasket.com/player.php?id=702&sez=05 Adriatic League player profile] *[http://www.nba.com/draft2008/profiles/NikolaPekovic.html NBA.com NBA draft profile] *[http://www.nbadraft.net/admincp/profiles/nikolapekovic.html NBAdraft.net player profile] *[http://www.draftexpress.com/profile/Nikola-Pekovic-1047/ Draftexpress.com player profile] *[http://www.blic.co.yu/sport.php?id=33370 Ja izbliza: Nikola Peković, košarkaš Partizana], ''Blic'', March 9, 2008 {{Panathinaikos BC Current Roster}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Pekovic, Nikola}} [[Category:1986 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:Montenegrin basketball players]] [[Category:KK Partizan players]] [[Category:Panathinaikos basketball players]] {{Euro-hoops-bio-stub}} {{Montenegro-bio-stub}} [[de:Nikola Peković]] [[fr:Nikola Peković]] [[sr:Никола Пековић]]
